purpose: For the prospectively frozen v078 pixel-followup population, select a compact, balanced set of independent APPLAUSE comparison plates before any comparison pixels are inspected, resolve official APPLAUSE DR4 scan URLs, and acquire selected scans with resumable transport and SHA256 provenance.

science_pair.comparison_plate_timing_note: Comparison exposure-start time is used only to rank otherwise eligible comparison opportunities by temporal proximity; it is not a new physical-overlap or disposition criterion.

comparison_selection.catalogue_positive_control: If a survivor has exactly one v078 STRICT_LE3 recurrence physical plate, include it as a positive pixel control.
comparison_selection.catalogue_context_control: If one or more v078 DIAGNOSTIC_GT3_LE5 or WIDE_GT5_LE15 physical plates exist, include the single nearest-to-target contextual plate, preferring DIAGNOSTIC over WIDE and then smaller separation.

sensitivity_negative_controls.eligible_definition: A v077a independent physical-plate opportunity with no v078 source_calib row within 15 arcsec on that physical plate.
sensitivity_negative_controls.selection_rule: Select nearest preceding and nearest following no-source physical plate within HAMBURG and BAMBERG families where available; prefer COVERED_INTERIOR, then smaller absolute time separation, then lower physical plate id. If a family lacks one side, fill to two from the nearest remaining no-source plates in that family. Then fill the overall target of four from the nearest remaining no-source opportunities regardless of archive family. Never substitute a 3-15 arcsec contextual source plate as a sensitivity-negative control.
sensitivity_negative_controls.timestamp_source: Parseable v077a exposure_start_values; for multiple starts use the start with minimum absolute separation from the science epoch.
sensitivity_negative_controls.unparseable_time: Retained as eligible but ranked after parseable timestamps; coverage class then physical plate id provides deterministic fallback.
sensitivity_negative_controls.shortfall_policy: Retain all available no-source controls and flag shortfall; do not broaden recurrence radii or change disposition.

scan_url_resolution.source: official APPLAUSE DR4 plate object page
scan_url_resolution.required_match: exact filename_scan link under /files/DR4/scans/ on the official plate page

acquisition.disk_free_guard: require free bytes >= outstanding expected bytes * 1.25 + 2 GiB before transfer

next_stage: Run target-independent local registration and frozen sensitivity/injection analysis on acquired comparison scans for all 23 survivors.
